# Mathkind

> > Mathkind connects math education with global citizenship through teacher training, STEM programs, and Global Math Stories across Guatemala, Ecuador, and beyond.

Mathkind (formerly T2TGlobal) is a nonprofit organization focused on improving math and STEM education in underserved communities, particularly in Guatemala and Ecuador. The organization operates programs including teacher training, Girls STEM Clubs, MathMobile, and Global Math Stories—a geography-integrated math curriculum featuring real-world locations and cultural connections.

## Key Topics

- Math education
- STEM education
- Teacher training
- Guatemala programs
- Ecuador programs

## Core Programs & Impact

- [Instructional Support](https://mathkind.org/instructional-support): Girls STEM Club program in Ecuador and Guatemala with teacher support
- [The Unique "Why" of T2TGlobal](https://mathkind.org/the-unique-why-of-t2tglobal): Executive Director Chadd McGlone on T2TGlobal's pedagogical philosophy
- [MathMobile Fuels Quality Education](https://mathkind.org/mathmobile-fuels-quality-education): Article on MathMobile program's virtual pivot during COVID in Guatemala
- [The S in STEM](https://mathkind.org/the-s-in-stem): Article on integrating science education in Guatemala STEM programs

## Field Stories & Reflections

- [A Tale of Two Villages](https://mathkind.org/a-tale-of-two-villages): Charlotte McGlone's account of visiting El Paredón & Santa Avelina schools
- [The Power of Self-Confidence in Santa Avelina](https://mathkind.org/the-power-of-self-confidence-in-santa-avelina): Lucía Dávila's reflection on teaching at William Botnan School, Guatemala
- [Finding Mathematics in All the Right Places](https://mathkind.org/finding-math): Linda Gojak and team's educational visit to Costa Rica and Guatemala
